duration: Until July 31, 2027 for the 2026-27 term; most boards meet in the evening
pay_detail: Unpaid. The page calls it a volunteer role.
name: Student Representatives on City Boards and Commissions
what_you_do: Sit on a city board or commission as a student rep. You might join the Library Board, Planning and Zoning, the Riverwalk board or the Transportation Advisory Board. You start with a leadership orientation.
who_can_apply: Students who live inside Naperville city limits. You are a sophomore, junior or senior. Freshmen cannot apply. If you already served on a board or commission, you cannot apply.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Click Apply on any board's page on the city Boards and Commissions site. Fill in the profile and the student rep questions. Upload a resume or a short statement. You can apply to up to three boards.
notes: 24 positions, two per board. Contact: Rachel Pruneda, prunedar@naperville.il.us, 630-420-6018. The dates come from an August 2026 city news post.
